BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP

The infernal noise was ramming into my comfortable unconsciousness, shooting a headache that made my eyebrows crease together. I pressed my hand against my face and pinched the bridge of my nose hard. I didn't want to wake into a crap morning, but the alarm wasn't giving any choice in the matter. I blew my nose and my mind took in the first breath of the day. I drew the second through my mouth and yelled.

"ALARM TURN OFF!"

BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP

Why wasn't the voice-command activator working? I paid good money to have that installed along with an acoustic room. I was feeling tired with a vein tangibly pressing against the skin of my temple. Growling, I threw the blank off my chest, twisted my torso, and swung my hand toward the offending noise.

BEEP BEEP BEEP SLAP BEEP BEEP

When I opened my eyes (feeling the crust in the corner), a huge blurry mass burst upward and threw off its blanket.

"Ah fuck, I can't believe you done this." The mass said in a groggy, low voice. "I know I told you to wake me up, but seriously, that really hurts."

BEEP BEEP BEEP SLAP

For some reason, everything was so out of focus that I could barely make out the facial features on the man sitting up next to me. My eyes only saw swaths of white skin where his head and neck was approximate and the glow of the sun radiating off of its borders. I could not see lines, only colors. I could feel my breaths becoming quicker.

"Oh no, the risk was supposed to be below 1%. I'm losing my sight! Where's my secretary! Have her call my optometrist!"

"Whoah, whoah, what are you talking about?" The figure undid my fingers that gripped his white t-shirt and reach his hand past me. "Look, calm down. Your glasses is always on your side."

Suddenly there were two windows through which colors became crisp and edges formed. In a moment, it covered my entire field of vision except around the edges. I could finally see who was lying next to me. The man with the bags under his eyes sighed combed his hand across his hair.

"Jeez, what's with you today?"

I took my pause to dive into my memory.

"Who are you?"

"MARV! I SWEAR TO GOD IF YOU DON'T TELL ME WHERE YOU HID THAT ALARM, I WILL PERSONALLY BITCH-SLAP YOUR DAMN FACE! GOD, WHERE IS MY GLASSES!"

U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is composed of three distinct enforcement arms: the Office of Border Patrol (OBP, otherwise known as the United States Border Patrol), the Office of Field Operations (OFO; commonly called by its former name 'Customs') and the Office of Air and Marine (OAM). OBP is tasked with securing the international border in-between the Ports of Entry (POE) and is a mobile enforcement agency that is structured and employed like any other uniformed police department in the United States. OFO is the federal law enforcement branch tasked with administering the POE's (air, land or sea) and is responsible for determining the admissibility of all persons and goods into the United States.
